Title: Kunal's Day

Cast

1. Kunal - 9 years, son
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
2. Meenakshi - 34 years, mother
Look: green saree
3. Manoj - 38 years, father
Look: white kurta-pyjama
4. Riya - 13 years, daughter
Look: red frock, a clip in her hair

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
3. The bedroom - a big bed, a wooden cupboard
4. The park - green grass, swings, benches

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Kunal stands in the living room. Meenakshi and Manoj stand near him.]

Manoj: "Today feels like a good day."

[Kunal eats his breakfast at the table.]

Kunal (softly): "And then?"

[Kunal drinks a glass of water.]

Meenakshi: "Really?"

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[Kunal stands in the courtyard. Meenakshi stands near him.]

Kunal: "So, here we are!"

[Kunal dances to the music.]

Kunal (gently): "That's great!"

[Kunal claps his hands.]

Meenakshi: "Really?"

[Kunal points at the sky.]

Kunal: "That's great!"

[Kunal scratches his head.]

Kunal: "And then?"

[Kunal whispers something to Mother.]

Kunal: "Careful!"

[Kunal shouts angrily.]

Kunal: "Yes, of course."

[Kunal gives Mother a flower.]

Kunal: "That was fun!"

Scene 3: The bedroom - Day

[Kunal stands in the bedroom. Meenakshi stands near him.]

Kunal: "Let's begin."

[Kunal goes to bed and falls asleep.]

Kunal: "Mom, look at this."

[Kunal sits on the edge of the bed.]

Meenakshi: "Yes, all right."

Scene 4: The park - Day

[Kunal stands in the park. Meenakshi stands near him.]

Meenakshi: "So, here we are!"

[Kunal goes jogging in the park.]

Kunal (happily): "Hmm, I see."

[Kunal plays cricket in the park.]

Meenakshi: "Good job, Kunal!"

[Kunal swings on the swing.]

Kunal (laughing): "Okay, Mom."

[Kunal goes down the slide.]

Meenakshi: "That was such a fun day!"
